TEXT:
This situation isn't looking good... I gotta find a way 
to get out of this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
That was... Over there! I tripped thanks to that 
bucket and...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: U-Using... an... excuse?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
It's not an excuse, whatever happened just now 
was inevitable!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
E-Even if it was inevitable, why would something like 
falling onto someone's chest even happen?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I-I wasn't aiming for that to happen... I can't help 
but trip... you just happened to be there.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: A-Aren't you gonna say anything?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: G-Geez... So you're blaming me for this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
N-Not at all, I didn't mean it that way... If I did 
anything to put you off, I apologize for that. Sorry, 
it's my fault.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: I-It's not like I want you to apologize but...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: It's really embarrassing, for me in particular...

I didn't expect that kind of reaction in such a 
situation but... she's kinda cute when she's 
embarrassed.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ...Y-You're leering at my chest again?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I-I would never, absolutely not! I am reflecting 
upon my actions!
Crap, it's getting increasingly awkward...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: I-In the first place, you...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
You um, can't just keep clinging onto me as long as 
you like...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I-I...It isn't something that happens often so, I kinda 
lost my head for a moment.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
When I saw you I just started... reminiscing... and I 
forgot to pull back...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Re... Reminiscing? What were you even thinking 
about on my chest!? Is it about a H-Game again?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: N-No! You're wrong! It wasn't that kind of thought!

It was my fault for reminiscing while buried in her 
chest, but I can't just say that...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ...W-Well...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
You're repenting, so there's no point blaming you 
about this...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: In any case, I messed up. Don't be mad, please?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ...O-Okay.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I hold some responsibility in bumping into you as 
well, so I'll let this one go.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
But, next time this happens, I'm telling my brother, 
got it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Y-Yeah, I got it.

If Kouhei found out about this, things might've 
turned out a lot more troublesome... I'm glad I was 
able to avoid that this time.
